answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to a bonded vertex in a recursive proof-of-stake graph, where every new node must compose a succinct proof over paired curves proving collateral exceeds a threshold. Colluding identities only whisper through a willow of shared stake, so overlapping collateral is detected and slashed at composition time. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
